instruction: Set up the dining table for dinner, place the tableware/cutleries and glass on the dining table. Also bring something romantic to the dining table.
add_act: place_on(<agent>, <item_1>, <item_2>, <room>): For placing <item_1> on <item_2>, <agent> and <item_2> must be in <room>, <item_1> must be pickable and accessible, <item_2> must be dining_table, <agent> is loaded and has <item_1>. As result, <item_1> is on <item_2> in <room>, <agent> is not loaded and does not has <item_1> anymore.
